title: Harness Guard Routing
desc: Compact guard index for refusal reasons, safe routes, and recovery commands.
steps: GUARD 2 KILL-GUARD [PS]: blocks Stop-Process/Kill-Process on wkappbot-core/wkchat/wkappbot/wka11y. Fix: wkappbot taskkill /IM <exe>. //why:will follow kill-guard taskkill not stop-process-sonnet
GUARD 3 SKILL-SEARCH-NUDGE [Bash/Glob/Grep]: soft exit-0 nudge to run skill search before grepping. No block.
GUARD 4 SKILL-EDIT-GUARD [Edit/Write]: blocks direct .skill.json edits. Fix: skill edit <id> or skill contribute.
GUARD 5 PACE-GUARD [Edit/Write, Sonnet]: Sonnet over-pace -> delegate or wkedit. -> harness-pace-guard
GUARD 6 CP949-GUARD [Write]: non-CP949 char -> ASCII or Hangul only.
GUARD 9 STALL-GUARD [all tools except Agent]: solo loop over threshold -> delegate or knowledge-ify (instant reset). -> harness-stall-guard
GUARD 7 AGENT-BRIEF-GUARD [Agent]: fewer than 3 valid skill-read refs -> add 3, incl agent-on-load + model reflection. -> harness-agent-brief-guard
GUARD 8 OPUS-BUDGET-GUARD [Agent, opus]: over 95pct weekly budget -> Agent model haiku instead, or wait for reset. -> harness-opus-budget-guard
GUARD 11 AGENTS-HEAL-GUARD [any tool, once/session]: self-heals AGENTS.md Commit Gate section, no action needed.
GUARD 12 COMMIT-HOOK-GUARD [Bash/PS, git commit]: self-heals core.hooksPath + cp949 guard install, no action needed.

GUARD 13 SPEC-GATE [Agent, opus]: an Opus Agent() call missing a literal SPEC: line + 5 numbered items (Goal/Files/Approach/Constraints/Exit) is blocked. Fix: prepend SPEC: then numbered 1.Goal 2.Files 3.Approach 4.Constraints 5.Exit. -> harness-agent-brief-guard
GUARD 14 CLAUDE-MD-SYNC [Agent]: Agent dispatch is blocked when CLAUDE.md Pending section has no matching recent entry. Fix: add a Pending checkbox line first, then retry. -> agent-dispatch-preflight
GUARD 15 WKCLAUDE-DIRECT [Bash/PS]: a direct wkclaude call not routed through Agent.cmd is blocked. Fix: route through Agent.cmd instead. -> wkharness-guards-howto

NAVIGATION: this T1 core holds ONLY the 15 guard reflex lines above. Unblock recipes and per-guard detail live in wkharness-guards-howto (T2). Dated incidents, internals, and the heart-v2 dispatch model live in wkharness-guards-ref (T3). STANDING RULE (re-affirmed 2026-07-24 after a 2nd bloat-to-33-steps cycle): new lessons go to -ref first (or -howto if confirmed-recurring), NEVER appended here directly -- keep this base at true one-line reflexes only. A future session finding this core bloated again should re-run this exact trim (archive dated steps to -ref via add-step, then --steps-json replace core with just the guard list).
